generation.scope: There is no branching at any opposite rank for a pure-relation-free standard regular window whose projections are curves or points. Both remaining global frames are impossible: comparison of two rank-two residual blocks excludes the four-center frame, and a common binary root with incompatible projected relation supports excludes the three-center frame. Together with the surface and curve-graph theorems this gives finite all-degree regularity and indexed-isomorphism tests for every pure-free candidate with a positive-dimensional projection.

open_mathematics: Analyze the remaining branched cases with decomposable quadratic relations and the unbranched windows with nonsplit closed orbit. Use the local path and rank bounds without imposing domain or noetherian hypotheses.
